design.metaphor: The tail of a Q slips free.
design.supporting_idea: The notch defines the slipping tail without a second object.
design.primary_silhouette: Rounded-square Q with a short notched tail.

optical_occupancy.notes: Thresholded on the 1024 px SVG render; right and bottom are exclusive. Reviewed in Composer with the grid and beside Calculator and Notes through NSWorkspace.

background_strategy.reason: Keep the approved slate in Default, and let macOS adapt the field in Dark.

geometry_contract.occlusion_rule: One foreground above a solid root; no source extrusion.

groups.name: Group
groups.purpose: One Q face with automatic edge lighting.

default.notes: Peach Q with a narrow highlight against slate.

dark.notes: The same peach Q stays distinct on the darker, system-adapted field.

clear_light.notes: Light neutral Q on a mid-gray field; see appearances.png.

clear_dark.notes: Light neutral Q on charcoal; the central counter stays open.

tinted_light.notes: Near-white face on a violet field in the stock tint export.

tinted_dark.notes: The system violet tint is darker than its light counterpart. The PNG was untagged; visually reviewed, no ICC-managed contrast claim.

source_audit.notes: Strict-flat audit: one SVG, zero warnings or errors; Composer and Sketch export bytes match.

flat_preview_64.notes: The Q and counter are recognizable in the reduced preview.

optical_scale.notes: Reviewed with the official grid and against system app icons; workspace-neighbors.png.

geometry_integrity.notes: No independent crossing; 98.6% silhouette IoU against approved reference.

material_edge_integrity.notes: Continuous exterior and counter edge; no extra bevel at the tail junction in Composer.

transform_audit.notes: Full-canvas transparent SVG, X/Y zero, scale 100%, no rotation.

background_appearance.notes: Slate in Default; Dark adapts to a nearly black field in the rendering.

rendered_matrix.notes: Six platform appearances at 64 and 1024 px; reviewed stock tint. Did not test every wallpaper or user-selected tint.

color_audit.notes: Default ICC-to-sRGB interior pair measured 6.388052:1 and D50 delta L* 54.193241.

export_decode.notes: verify_icon_exports.py confirmed six of six native 64 px exports with all six appearances.

reopen_check.notes: Reopened Resources/Slipway.icon in Icon Composer: root, group and 01_slipway-q present; checked render and saved the final mono override.

simulator_or_device.notes: Built and tested on the host Mac. NSWorkspace rendered the Release bundle at 32, 64 and 256 px.

qa.dynamic_color_notes: The reported color pair is the default exported interior sample; it is not a minimum across tints.
